title: Costas array of order 33
statement: Find a permutation p of 1..33 such that the 528 vectors (j - i, p(j) - p(i)), i < j, are pairwise distinct: a Costas array of order 33. Costas arrays are known for every order up to 31, but none is known for the orders 32 and 33. A valid array scores 1 and settles the order.
submission: Text file: 33 integers, a permutation of 1..33 (or of 0..32), separated by spaces, commas or newlines; the i-th number is the row of the dot in column i.
score: 1 for a Costas array of order 33; none is known, so the best known value is 0

best_known.source: no Costas array of order 33 is known: K. Drakakis, Open problems in Costas arrays, arXiv:1102.5727, section 3.2 ('the smallest values of n for which no Costas array of order n is currently known are n = 32 and 33') and Table 1; read 9 Nov 2026
